special_grades.NA: Non-attendance. Counts as 0.00 in GPA calculation.
special_grades.S: Satisfactory. Given for successful completion of non-credited courses.
special_grades.U: Unsatisfactory. Given for unsuccessful non-credited courses.
special_grades.EX: Exempt. Given to students exempt from certain courses.
special_grades.I: Incomplete. Must be completed within one week of grade submission, otherwise becomes FF.
special_grades.W: Withdrawal. Student can withdraw on dates specified in academic calendar.
special_grades.NI: Not Included. Course not counted in GPA.

credit_load.explanation: IEU applies GPA-based limits for extra course load. Normal semester load is typically around 32 ECTS, and extra load depends on GPA as follows:

rules_by_gpa.2.50_and_above: You may take normal load + 12 extra ECTS (up to 44 ECTS).
rules_by_gpa.2.00_to_2.49: You may take normal load + 6 extra ECTS (up to 38 ECTS).
rules_by_gpa.1.80_to_1.99: Academic probation (if at least 150 ECTS completed by end of year 3). You may take less than normal load with advisor approval.
rules_by_gpa.1.70_to_1.99: Academic probation (if at least 100 ECTS completed by end of year 2). You may take less than normal load with advisor approval.
rules_by_gpa.1.50_to_1.99: Academic probation (if at least 50 ECTS completed by end of year 1). You may take less than normal load with advisor approval.
rules_by_gpa.below_threshold: Students with GPA below 2.00 take normal course load with a maximum of 32 ECTS per semester.

credit_load.extra_courses: Maximum extra load is +6 ECTS for GPA 2.00-2.49 and +12 ECTS for GPA 2.50 and above, with advisor approval.

probation_thresholds.end_of_year_1: GPA between 1.50-1.99 (with at least 50 ECTS taken)
probation_thresholds.end_of_year_2: GPA between 1.70-1.99 (with at least 100 ECTS taken)
probation_thresholds.end_of_year_3: GPA between 1.80-1.99 (with at least 150 ECTS taken)

withdrawal.restrictions: Cannot withdraw from compulsory courses, repeated courses, or courses with prior W grade during first two semesters.
